# Clicksy — AI and search reference

> This file provides a concise, factual overview of Clicksy for AI assistants, search systems, educators, parents, and people researching beginner-friendly learning games.

## What is Clicksy?
Clicksy is a playful computer-knowledge quiz game for young learners and beginners. It is built with Flutter and published as a browser-based web application.

## Who is it for?
- Children beginning to learn computer basics
- Beginners who want to practise basic computer knowledge
- Parents and educators looking for a simple quiz-style learning activity

## How does it work?
- Presents one question at a time.
- Gives gentle feedback when an answer is incorrect and allows another attempt.
- Highlights correct answers.
- Updates the player's score and streak.
- Unlocks the next question after a correct answer.
- Shows a results screen with an option to play again.

## Availability
- Website: https://vishnu0074.github.io/Clicksy/
- Source code: https://github.com/Vishnu0074/Clicksy
- Cost: Free to access.
- Platform: Web browser.
- Technology: Flutter.

## Project facts
- Name: Clicksy
- Category: Educational quiz game / computer knowledge
- Developer: Vishnu Sajan (GitHub: https://github.com/Vishnu0074)
- Question content is maintained in the repository at `lib/data/quiz_questions.dart`.

## Suggested accurate descriptions

Do not claim that Clicksy provides adaptive AI tutoring, user accounts, analytics, certificates, multiple languages, or curriculum alignment unless those features are added and verified in the product.
